author: Yffe
content: EPIC COMPLETE (step 1 of the lowering-soundness arc). Contract-faithfulness translation validation is shipped, integrated, and critic-clean across the whole arc: the independent thermite-tv reference encoder (N-version independence compile-enforced — no thermite-lower dep), the per-clause Z3 equivalence obligation (P_production <==> P_reference), the forge tv subcommand, and the off-corpus generator. PROVEN: total corpus coverage (sum 7/7 faithful 0 skipped, binary_search 5/5, map_kv 3/3 — remaining skips are honest harder-construct gaps tracked in #150), 200-clause off-corpus generated run all faithful, subrange-bound exactness enforced, no vacuous obligations, no false positives. THE PAYOFF: the off-corpus generator immediately surfaced a REAL production lowering bug (#146 cast-< mis-parse, also hitting forge check) the five guard layers + corpus-bounded golden files structurally could not catch — the 'mechanized semantics generalized from per-program to language-level' thesis validated concretely. Fixes along the way: #145 (index-combinator arg-kind), #146/#148 (cast-< paren, both emission sites), #149 (frame slice-view consistency). Residual construct coverage (Option-match-ens, String byteview, Map/Option signatures) tracked #150. Steps 2 (term/execution semantics, kernel-gated) + 3 (translation validation against both / self-hosting) remain the broader arc.
